summary: Keep loaded pinned Finance statements out of routine completion refresh while updating account-setup dependencies. Local only.
noAssistantImpact: Dashboard cache wiring only. Shared completion retains current Finance refreshes, error recovery, Close and toast ordering. Only successful loaded accountActivity/accountLedger keys with canonical fixed sequence avoid invalidation; latest/failed/pending/unknown reads and report metadata remain refreshable. Money-account creation explicitly refreshes cached Order payment choices; Finance setup additionally refreshes cached Customer account Book availability. Category creation keeps its existing Finance-only effect. Existing payment-settings/bank-details callbacks, native command payloads, financial locks/permissions, recovery identities, snapshots, API and assistant capabilities are unchanged. No schema, provider, command submission or deployment.

docs.note: No financial API, private access, input/output or command/transaction change.
No database schema, persistence, migration or index change.

evidence.result: Actual shared completion and Account/Setup form callbacks: before correction a held loaded statement blocks Close/toast and account/setup omit related reads. After correction live cache markers refresh, loaded fixed statement/ledger markers stay untouched, metadata reports and failed statements refresh, account/setup dependencies match their effects and category avoids extra identity reads. Only inert cache functions; no API operation or mutation permitted.

Public tRPC keys verify normal/infinite fixed sequences including zero/max, malformed/latest inputs, loaded/error/pending/absent data, unknown/prefixed layouts and report/journal/other-domain conservatism.
